title: Swap payment strategies at runtime
description: PaymentProcessor accepts a PaymentStrategy and delegates to it when pay() is called. Implement CreditCardStrategy, PayPalStrategy, and CryptoStrategy, each printing a distinct confirmation. The processor should be able to swap strategies at runtime without any changes to itself.
hints: PaymentStrategy is an interface with a single pay(double amount) method returning a String
Each concrete strategy returns a message that identifies itself and includes the amount
issues: Without the Strategy pattern, adding a new payment method requires modifying PaymentProcessor with more if/else branches
Payment logic is scattered inside the processor instead of encapsulated in interchangeable classes
overallGoal: Use the Strategy pattern so PaymentProcessor delegates payment behaviour to whichever strategy it holds, and new payment methods can be added without touching the processor.
goals: Each strategy returns a confirmation message containing the amount
PaymentProcessor delegates to its current strategy
Swapping strategy at runtime changes the payment behaviour immediately
